scenes.text: Sometimes the best ideas come when you give yourself space.
scenes.visual_hint: lone tree on the left side of a wide empty field

scenes.text: A single light can guide you home through the dark.
scenes.visual_hint: lighthouse at the right edge of a wide rocky coastline

scenes.text: Leave room on the page for the things you have not imagined yet.
scenes.visual_hint: small sailboat far on the left of a wide calm sea

scenes.text: And keep moving, even when the road ahead looks long.
scenes.visual_hint: cyclist riding along the right edge of a long empty road
